entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: the vendored parser's function table (promql/parser/functions.go) pins `sort`/`sort_desc` at ArgTypes:[]ValueType{ValueTypeVector} with no Variadic field (defaults to 0) — exactly one required vector argument, non-optional — so lowerCall's "sort", "sort_desc" case can never route a call with len(c.Args) != 1 to lowerSort.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s expects at least 1 argument (vector[, label…]), got %d
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: sort_by_label is declared Variadic -1 over one mandatory instant-vector argument, so a zero-argument call never parses
